sentences.en: My name is Jordan Kistner.
sentences.zh: 我叫乔丹·克斯特纳。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer for The New York Times Magazine and I've been teaching writing to university students for most of the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人，在过去的近10年里，我一直在大学里教学生写作。

sentences.en: This week's Sunday read is my story for the magazine about a cluster of suicides that struck a small university in Massachusetts between 2021 and 2022.
sentences.zh: 本周的“周日阅读”是我为该杂志撰写的故事，讲述了2021年至2022年期间袭击马萨诸塞州一所小型大学的一连串自杀事件。

sentences.en: I wrote about how the mental health crisis among college-age students is affecting the staff who teach and care for them and how it's shaping the broader institution of college
sentences.zh: 我写了大学年龄段学生的心理健康危机是如何影响那些教导和关怀他们的教职员工的，以及它如何塑造了更广泛的大学体制

sentences.en: in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: So in the summer of 2021, students at Worcester Polytechnic Institute, which is a STEM-focused
sentences.zh: 因此，在2021年夏天，伍斯特理工学院的学生——这是一所侧重于STEM（科学、技术、工程、数学）的

sentences.en: university of about 5,000 undergraduates, received an email from their administration.
sentences.zh: 拥有约5,000名本科生的大学，收到了一封来自学校行政部门的电子邮件。

sentences.en: A rising senior had died, and the Boston Globe leader reported it as a suicide.
sentences.zh: 一名大四学生去世了，《波士顿环球报》头条报道这是一起自杀事件。

sentences.en: Then, a few days before classes started, news of a second suicide appeared in the students' inboxes.
sentences.zh: 接着，在开学前几天，第二起自杀的消息出现在学生的收件箱里。

sentences.en: And then by the end of September, a third.
sentences.zh: 然后到了9月底，又发生了第三起。

sentences.en: It was every academic institution's worst nightmare, a row of self-inflicted student deaths, proceeding more or less with one death a month for six months.
sentences.zh: 这是所有学术机构最大的噩梦，一连串学生自杀身亡，在六个月里几乎以每月一人的速度发生。

sentences.en: The students who took their lives hadn't really shown any of the conventional warning signs.
sentences.zh: 那些结束自己生命的学生的并未真正表现出任何常规的警告信号。

sentences.en: There was this helpless feeling among professors.
sentences.zh: 教授们有一种无助感。

sentences.en: Any of their students could be at lethal risk, and they might not know.
sentences.zh: 他们的任何学生都可能处于致命的危险之中，而他们可能一无所知。

sentences.en: And one terrifying aspect of a suicide cluster like this is that you never know if another death is coming, or when.
sentences.zh: 这种自杀群聚事件的一个可怕之处在于，你永远不知道是否还会有另一次死亡，也不知道会何时发生。

sentences.en: And so, the university's president at the time formed a task force that would evaluate in as data-based a way as possible what factors might be contributing to this mental health
sentences.zh: 因此，当时的大学校长成立了一个特别工作组，以尽可能基于数据的方式评估可能导致这场心理健康

sentences.en: emergency.
sentences.zh: 危机的因素。

sentences.en: What struck me was that, in the midst of this moment of intense panic and improvisation, staff members started doing things that in the past might have been seen as overly involved
sentences.zh: 让我震惊的是，在这场强烈恐慌和临机应变的过程中，教职员工开始做一些在过去可能被视为过度介入

sentences.en: or too generous.
sentences.zh: 或过于慷慨的事情。

sentences.en: The school encouraged professors to start talking about their own mental health struggles in class if they were comfortable.
sentences.zh: 如果觉得自在，学校鼓励教授在课堂上开始谈论他们自己的心理健康挣扎。

sentences.en: One professor I spoke to gave out his cell phone number and would text students to make sure they were okay if he didn't see them in class.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一位教授给出了自己的手机号码，如果他在课堂上没看到学生，就会发短信确保他们安好。

sentences.en: Another I spoke with stocked up a fridge with chili so that students would never need to worry about affording dinner.
sentences.zh: 我采访的另一位教授在冰箱里备满了辣椒肉酱，这样学生们就永远不需要担心负担不起晚餐。

sentences.en: The dean of arts and sciences started making a point to look students and staff in the eye because she noticed that as all this was happening, people stopped looking at each
sentences.zh: 艺术与科学学院院长开始刻意注视学生和教职员工的眼睛，因为她注意到随着这一切发生，人们不再直视

sentences.en: other head-on.
sentences.zh: 彼此的脸。

sentences.en: It was almost too vulnerable, she thought.
sentences.zh: 她想，这几乎是过于脆弱了。

sentences.en: And she wanted people to know that they weren't alone, even if they were too shut down in the moment to receive that message.
sentences.zh: 她希望人们知道他们并不孤单，即使他们当时正处于过度封闭状态而无法接收到这个信息。

sentences.en: I was really moved by these small gestures in the face of an enormous tragedy.
sentences.zh: 面对巨大的悲剧，这些微小的姿态深深打动了我。

sentences.en: But I also wanted to know how taking on these pseudo-therapeutic roles was affecting faculty members.
sentences.zh: 但我也想了解，承担这些准治疗角色对教职员工产生了什么影响。

sentences.en: The issue of mental health crises in college students isn't new.
sentences.zh: 大学生心理健康危机的问题并不新鲜。

sentences.en: A National Institutes of Health study from a decade ago found that about 1,100 college students were dying by suicide each year, and about 24,000 were attempting it.
sentences.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院十年前的一项研究发现，每年约有1,100名大学生因自杀身亡，约有24,000人曾尝试自杀。

sentences.en: But that was 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但那是10年前的事了。

sentences.en: That was before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 那是在大流行爆发之前。

sentences.en: And since 2020, faculty told me, there's been a general sense of deluge when it comes to mental health on campuses.
sentences.zh: 教职员工告诉我，自2020年以来，在校园心理健康方面，有一种被淹没的普遍感觉。

sentences.en: Professors have always been used to having some subset of students in class who were struggling about whom they were concerned.
sentences.zh: 教授们一向习惯了班上总会有一些苦苦挣扎、令他们担忧的学生群体。

sentences.en: But the numbers became more than they knew how to handle.
sentences.zh: 但人数变得超出了他们的处理能力。

sentences.en: What emerged from my reporting is this story of immense distress about a bunch of educators
sentences.zh: 我的报道呈现出的是这样一个故事：一群教育工作者面临着巨大的痛苦

sentences.en: trying to shepherd students in crisis while themselves feeling overwhelmed, burnt out, and a little bit under-resourced.
sentences.zh: 试图引导陷入危机的学生，而他们自己却感到不知所措、筋疲力尽且资源略显不足。

sentences.en: But it's also a story of educators who were willing to be creative, responsive, and adaptive to lift their community out of a crisis like this over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一个关于教育工作者的故事，他们愿意保持创造力、响应能力和适应能力，一次又一次地将他们的社区从这样的危机中拯救出来。

sentences.en: People I spoke with at WPI stressed to me that the way you get through something like this as a community is openness.
sentences.zh: 我在伍斯特理工学院交谈过的人向我强调，作为一个社区度过这样难关的方法就是开放。

sentences.en: Transparency about the hurt that's happening.
sentences.zh: 对正在发生的伤痛保持透明。

sentences.en: And that no individual, no one counseling center, no one overachieving professor can solve this kind of problem alone.
sentences.zh: 而且没有任何个人、没有哪一个心理咨询中心、没有哪一个过度成就的教授能够独自解决这种问题。

sentences.en: You only get out the other side through the immense and loving work of many, many, many, many people.
sentences.zh: 唯有通过许许多多、许许多多人的巨大而充满爱的工作，才能度过难关。

sentences.en: And that's a hard thing to implement on a policy level.
sentences.zh: 这在政策层面上很难落实。

sentences.en: But at WPI, that was what it took.
sentences.zh: 但在伍斯特理工学院，这就是所需要做到的。

sentences.en: So, here's my article, The Unthinkable Mental Health Crisis That Shook a New England College, read by Emily Wu Zeller.
sentences.zh: 那么，这就是我的文章《震撼新英格兰一所大学的不可思议的心理健康危机》，由艾米莉·吴·泽勒（Emily Wu Zeller）朗读。

sentences.zh: 我们今天的音频制作人是阿德里安·赫斯特（Adrian Hurst）。

sentences.zh: 你将听到的原创音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托（Aaron Esposito）创作和演奏。

sentences.en: The first death happened before the academic year began.
sentences.zh: 第一起死亡事件发生在学年开始之前。

sentences.en: In July 2021, an undergraduate student at Worcester Polytechnic Institute was reported dead.
sentences.zh: 2021年7月，据报道伍斯特理工学院的一名本科生身亡。

sentences.en: The administration sent a notice out over email, with the familiar, thoroughly vetted phrasing and appended resources.
sentences.zh: 校方通过电子邮件发布了一则通知，使用了熟悉、经过彻底审查的措辞并附上了相关资源。

sentences.en: Catherine Fu, an assistant professor in the Department of Integrative and Global Studies, felt especially crushed by the news.
sentences.zh: 综合与全球研究系助理教授凯瑟琳·傅（Catherine Fu）对这个消息感到格外心碎。

sentences.en: She taught this student.
sentences.zh: 她教过这个学生。

sentences.en: He was Chinese-American.
sentences.zh: 他是美籍华人。

sentences.en: And she felt connected to the particular set of pressures he faced.
sentences.zh: 她对这位学生所面临的种种特定压力感同身受。

sentences.en: She read through old, anonymous course evaluations, looking for any sign she might have missed.
sentences.zh: 她翻阅了过去的匿名课程评估，寻找任何她可能错过的迹象。

sentences.en: But she was unsure where to put her personal feelings about a loss suffered in this professional context.
sentences.zh: 但她不确定该如何安放自己对于在这一职业语境下遭受的损失的个人情感。

sentences.en: What was the appropriate channel for processing, either with co-workers or students, the sorrow and fear that the death of a student inspired?
sentences.zh: 无论是与同事还是学生一起，消化由一名学生的离去所引发的悲伤和恐惧，什么才是合适的渠道？

sentences.en: Fu went on, preparing for her fall classes.
sentences.zh: 傅继续前行，为秋季课程做准备。

sentences.en: The week before the academic year began, a second student died.
sentences.zh: 在学年开始前的一周，第二名学生去世了。

sentences.en: A rising senior in the computer science department, who loved horticulture, took his own life.
sentences.zh: 计算机科学系的一名大四准毕业生、热爱园艺的他结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: This brought an intimation of disaster.
sentences.zh: 这带来了灾难的预兆。

sentences.en: One student's suicide is a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 一个学生的自杀是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: Two might be the beginning of a cluster.
sentences.zh: 两个可能就是群聚事件的开始。

sentences.en: Some faculty members began to feel a tinge of dread when they stepped onto campus.
sentences.zh: 一些教职员工一踏上校园就开始感到一丝恐惧。

sentences.en: Worcester Polytechnic Institute in Massachusetts is a tidy New England college campus, with the high-saturation landscaping typical of well-funded institutions.
sentences.zh: 位于马萨诸塞州的伍斯特理工学院是一个整洁的新英格兰大学校园，拥有资金充足的机构所特有的高饱和度绿化景观。

sentences.en: The hedges are beautifully trimmed.
sentences.zh: 树篱修剪得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: The pathways are swept clean.
sentences.zh: 小路被清扫得干干净净。

sentences.en: Red-brick buildings from the 19th century fraternize with high-glass facades and renovated interiors, a new sports complex, a new well-being center.
sentences.zh: 19世纪的红砖建筑与高耸的玻璃外墙、翻新后的内部空间、全新的综合体育中心以及全新的身心健康中心相映成趣。

sentences.en: Students were still not allowed to congregate in large groups, so the lush quads and dining halls were eerily silent.
sentences.zh: 学生们仍然不允许成群结队地聚集，因此郁郁葱葱的方庭和食堂诡异地安静。

sentences.en: The following Wednesday, students began classes, with the option of zooming in from their dorMs.
sentences.zh: 随后的星期三，学生们开始上课，并可以选择在宿舍里通过Zoom远程连线。

sentences.en: Some WPI faculty members continued scaled-down versions of teaching strategies they developed
sentences.zh: 一些伍斯特理工学院的教职员工继续使用精简版的教学策略，这些策略是他们在

sentences.en: during the pandemic, pre-recording lectures, holding seminars over Zoom, and experimenting with ways to have lab sessions with only 12 students present.
sentences.zh: 大流行期间开发的，包括预先录制讲座、通过Zoom举办研讨会，并试验仅有12名学生在场的实验室课程。

sentences.en: Fastening air glasses to the heads of the 12 so everyone else could watch from their dorms had not worked very well.
sentences.zh: 把智能眼镜固定在这12个人的头上，以便其他所有人都能从宿舍观看，这种方法效果并不好。

sentences.en: The glasses ran out of battery power too soon, and they gave people headaches.
sentences.zh: 眼镜的电池电量耗尽得太快，而且还让人头疼。

sentences.en: The leaves began to turn in Worcester.
sentences.zh: 伍斯特的树叶开始变色了。

sentences.en: WPI had possible risk factors for mental health issues and suicide among the student body.
sentences.zh: 伍斯特理工学院存在可能导致学生群体出现心理健康问题和自杀的风险因素。

sentences.en: Its academic culture was fast-paced and intense.
sentences.zh: 它的学术文化节奏快且强度大。

sentences.en: The enrolled students skewed male.
sentences.zh: 入学的学生中男性居多。

sentences.en: There was a comparatively high number of neurodivergent and introverted students who might struggle to maintain the social bonds that help protect against psychological challenges.
sentences.zh: 神经多样性和内向的学生比例相对较高，他们可能难以维持有助于抵御心理挑战的社交纽带。

sentences.en: But then, in 2021, risk factors for every type of student were elevated.
sentences.zh: 但在2021年，各种类型学生的风险因素都在上升。

sentences.en: Charlie Morse, who was the school's director of counseling from 2006 to 2021 and is now the
sentences.zh: 查理·莫尔斯（Charlie Morse）曾在2006年至2021年担任该校的咨询中心主任，现在是

sentences.en: dean of student wellness, told me that until that point in his tenure, WPI had lost two students to suicide, well below the national average.
sentences.zh: 学生健康院长，他告诉我，在他任职的这段时间的那个节点之前，伍斯特理工学院只有两名学生因自杀身亡，远低于全国平均水平。

sentences.en: Still, he had seen the worst case play out at other schools.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他曾在其他学校见过最糟糕的情况上演。

sentences.en: Morse is a slender, soft-voiced man in his early 60s.
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯身材苗条，声音轻柔，年过六旬。

sentences.en: He has worked at the school for more than 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他在该校工作了30多年。

sentences.en: When he tried to describe to me what it felt like to come to work in the fall of 2021, there was a tremor in his voice.
sentences.zh: 当他试图向我描述2021年秋天去上班的感觉时，他的声音有些颤抖。

sentences.en: It's like, oh please, not us, he told me, sitting in his office recently.
sentences.zh: 就像是，噢求求了，千万别是我们，他不久前坐在办公室里对我说。

sentences.en: Not us.
sentences.zh: 千万别是我们。

sentences.en: He swallowed.
sentences.zh: 他咽了咽口水。

sentences.en: A third student died before September was up.
sentences.zh: 9月还没过完，第三名学生就去世了。

sentences.en: It was a very dark time on campus, Fu told me.
sentences.zh: 傅对我说，那是校园里非常黑暗的一段时期。

sentences.en: Faculty were being asked to take on a role that I think historically we haven't been asked to play.
sentences.zh: 大家要求教职员工承担起一个我认为历史上从未被要求扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Her own anxiety intensified.
sentences.zh: 她自己的焦虑加剧了。

sentences.en: She felt herself tensing any time she looked at her work email.
sentences.zh: 她发现每当自己查看工作邮箱时就会感到一阵紧张。

sentences.en: Even when there was no crisis announcement, faculty and staff members flooded one another's
sentences.zh: 即使没有危机公告，教职员工也会用长长的群发邮件链轰炸彼此的

sentences.en: inboxes with long group email chains, processing fear and rage that had nowhere else to go.
sentences.zh: 收件箱，宣泄无处可去的恐惧和愤怒。

sentences.en: Their lives were also upended by the isolation, illness, and chaos of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们自己的生活也被大流行的孤立、疾病和混乱彻底打乱了。

sentences.en: Simultaneously, they felt as if they were the first-line responders to students in crisis.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们觉得自己就像是危机中学生的第一响应者。

sentences.en: But they weren't trained or equipped for the level of distress.
sentences.zh: 但他们并未接受过应对这种程度痛苦的培训，也没有配备相应的装备。

sentences.en: Our brain could get used to almost anything, says Gene King, the Dean of Arts and Sciences and a professor in the biology and biotechnology department.
sentences.zh: 艺术与科学院长、生物学和生物技术系教授吉恩·金（Gene King）说，我们的大脑几乎可以习惯任何事情。

sentences.en: But we can't get used to something that's unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 但我们无法习惯不可预测的事情。

sentences.en: King is a distinguished scientist who has spent decades researching the neuroscience of stress,
sentences.zh: 金是一位杰出的科学家，几十年来一直致力于研究压力的神经科学，

sentences.en: in particular the way in which black Americans and other oppressed people experience the physiological effects of systemic disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 特别是黑人美国人和其他受压迫人群经历系统性不利条件的生理影响的方式。

sentences.en: King, who is a black woman, is known on campus for being passionate, warm, and wedded to her job.
sentences.zh: 金是一位黑人女性，在校园里以充满激情、热情温暖以及对工作忠诚而闻名。

sentences.en: She explained to me that stress becomes toxic, and resilience becomes harder when the stressor seems random and erratic.
sentences.zh: 她向我解释说，当压力源显得随机且反复无常时，压力就会变成毒性，韧性也变得更加困难。

sentences.en: If it's unpredictable, my brain doesn't know what to expect next, she told me.
sentences.zh: 如果它是不可预测的，我的大脑就不知道接下来会发生什么，她对我说。

sentences.en: That's not a place my brain likes.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的大脑喜欢的地方。

sentences.en: No brain likes it.
sentences.zh: 没有任何大脑会喜欢。

sentences.en: So my brain is experiencing two things.
sentences.zh: 所以我的大脑正在经历两件事。

sentences.en: It can't predict what's going to happen, and it can't control it if it does happen.
sentences.zh: 它无法预测将要发生什么，如果真的发生了，它也无法控制。

sentences.en: So it has no way of getting ready for the situation.
sentences.zh: 因此它没有任何办法为这种情况做好准备。

sentences.en: In the wake of the third death, the university set up an emergency task force with a mandate to determine the possible causes of extreme student distress.
sentences.zh: 在第三起死亡事件发生后，该大学成立了一个紧急特别工作组，其职责是确定学生极端痛苦的可能原因。

sentences.en: Their job was to recommend data-backed interventions to the growing mental health crisis on campus.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是向校园内日益严重的心理健康危机推荐基于数据的干预措施。

sentences.en: The university's mental health and wellness protocols had always been aligned with the
sentences.zh: 该大学的心理健康和福祉协议一直与

sentences.en: leading edge of best practices, but evidently the industry's best practices weren't sufficient anymore.
sentences.zh: 最佳实践的前沿保持一致，但显然业界最佳实践已经不够用了。

sentences.en: Something had changed.
sentences.zh: 有什么改变了。

sentences.en: What was it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: What should come next?
sentences.zh: 接下来该做什么？

sentences.en: Worcester Polytechnic is a STEM-focused research university, and its curriculum emphasizes project-based learning.
sentences.zh: 伍斯特理工学院是一所专注于STEM的研究型大学，其课程强调基于项目的学习。

sentences.en: Students train toward junior and senior year projects that involve real-life impact, like developing
sentences.zh: 学生们为大三和大四的项目进行培训，这些项目具有现实生活中的影响，比如开发

sentences.en: a low-cost device to feed premature infants, or running analyses of the distribution system for Panama's National Water Authority to identify opportunities to minimize shortages.
sentences.zh: 用于喂养早产儿的低成本设备，或者对巴拿马国家水务局的配水系统进行分析，以找出最大限度减少短缺的机会。

sentences.en: Robots the size of small coolers on wheels scuttle around the quads delivering food to students in their dorms or labs.
sentences.zh: 像小型冷却器大小、带轮子的机器人穿梭于各个方庭，为宿舍或实验室的学生送餐。

sentences.en: The task force, led by King alongside Matt Berry, who was Morse's assistant director at the
sentences.zh: 特别工作组由金和马特·贝瑞（Matt Berry）共同领导，后者曾是莫尔斯在

sentences.en: Counseling Center, and including faculty and staff members and students from every part of the school, was also structured like a group project, first gathering data about what was
sentences.zh: 咨询中心的助理主任，成员包括来自学校各个部门的教职员工和学生，其结构也像是一个小组项目，首先收集关于问题的

sentences.en: wrong, then analyzing the data for patterns before recommending strategies for new policy.
sentences.zh: 数据，然后分析数据中的模式，最后推荐新政策的策略。

sentences.en: A second task force would oversee implementation.
sentences.zh: 第二个特别工作组将监督其实施。

sentences.en: WPI also asked the Riverside Trauma Center, a Boston-area organization that specializes in
sentences.zh: 伍斯特理工学院还请河滨创伤中心（Riverside Trauma Center）——一家专注于

sentences.en: crisis response and the aftermath of traumatic events, to conduct an independent review of the school's mental health practices.
sentences.zh: 危机应对和创伤事件后续处理的波士顿地区机构——对该校的心理健康做法进行独立审查。

sentences.en: It might have felt better, a few members of the task force suggested to me, if the university had
sentences.zh: 特别工作组的几位成员向我暗示，如果大学能够

sentences.en: leaped immediately to action, especially when the community was hurting and frightened.
sentences.zh: 立即采取行动，尤其是在社区受到伤害和惊恐的时候，感觉可能会更好。

sentences.en: But members of the task force thought that designing an intervention without first clearly defining the scope and nature of the problem was irrational and ineffectual.
sentences.zh: 但特别工作组的成员认为，在没有首先明确界定问题的范围和性质之前就设计干预措施是不理智且无效的。

sentences.en: This is a community of empiricists.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由经验主义者组成的社区。

sentences.en: Depending on their position on campus, everyone had a different opinion of what the problem was and how we needed to solve it.
sentences.zh: 根据他们在校园里的立场，每个人对问题是什么以及我们需要如何解决它都有不同的看法。

sentences.en: Kimberly LeChasser, a researcher and data analyst at the Morgan Teaching and Learning Center, who helped design the task force's research phase, told me,
sentences.zh: 摩根教学与学习中心的 پژوهشگر（研究员）兼数据分析师金伯利·勒沙瑟（Kimberly LeChasser）协助设计了特别工作组的研究阶段，她告诉我，

sentences.en: The idea was to get as neutral and comprehensive an understanding of the problem as possible, not limited by any one perspective.
sentences.zh: 我们的想法是尽可能对问题获得中立且全面的理解，不受任何单一观点的限制。

sentences.en: The task force organized a series of town hall events and listening sessions at which students could talk about their experiences of stress, anxiety, depression, and isolation.
sentences.zh: 特别工作组组织了一系列市政厅活动和听证会，学生们可以在会上谈论他们经历的压力、焦虑、抑郁和孤立感。

sentences.en: A series of smaller group conversations were used to assess particular experiences of stress.
sentences.zh: 一系列小组访谈被用来评估具体的压力体验。

sentences.en: Black students spoke with one another, led by a black professor.
sentences.zh: 黑人学生在一位黑人教授的带领下互相交谈。

sentences.en: LGBTQ plus students and first-generation students did the same.
sentences.zh: LGBTQ+学生和第一代大学生也做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: And so on.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类。

sentences.en: The school hosted town hall events for faculty and staff members and parents.
sentences.zh: 学校为教职员工和家长举办了市政厅会议。

sentences.en: Everyone on campus was invited to complete a written survey.
sentences.zh: 校园里的每个人都被邀请完成一份书面调查。

sentences.en: Among the professors, especially the junior teaching faculty, female professors, and scholars of color, there was consistent talk of burnout.
sentences.zh: 在教授中，特别是初级教师、女教授和有色人种学者中，关于精疲力竭的讨论此起彼伏。

sentences.en: Fu, who had joined the task force, was struck by this.
sentences.zh: 加入特别工作组的傅对此深有感触。

sentences.en: We heard from a lot of faculty that they were just very overwhelmed by the need for students to find a sympathetic ear and some guidance.
sentences.zh: 我们从许多教职员工那里听说，学生们非常需要一个倾听的耳朵和一些指导，这让他们感到不堪重负。

sentences.en: The students also reported feeling burned out and overwhelmed, specifically citing the feeling that their ability to perform academically
sentences.zh: 学生们还报告说感到精疲力竭、不堪重负，具体提到一种感觉，即他们在学业上的表现能力

sentences.en: was demanded at the expense of their feelings, health, and humanity.
sentences.zh: 被要求以牺牲他们的感情、健康和人性为代价。

sentences.en: The picture that emerged from the town halls wasn't altogether different from the complaints coming out of universities all over the country during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 从市政厅会议中浮现出的画面，与大流行期间全美各地大学的抱怨并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: More work than anyone could healthfully manage.
sentences.zh: 工作量超过了任何人健康管理的能力。

sentences.en: Less community resilience than people needed.
sentences.zh: 社区的韧性低于人们的需求。

sentences.en: Anxiety about what variables the future might bring.
sentences.zh: 对未来可能带来的变数的焦虑。

sentences.en: And no sense of when it would end.
sentences.zh: 而且不知道这一切何时会结束。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏旗下的益智游戏之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你们听过的那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: The fourth death came late at night.
sentences.zh: 第四起死亡发生在深夜。

sentences.en: It was November, and King was in bed next to her husband, a psychiatrist at a nearby hospital.
sentences.zh: 那是11月，金和身为附近医院精神科医生的丈夫躺在床上。

sentences.en: She assumed the ringing cell phone was his because he was sometimes on call.
sentences.zh: 她以为响起的手机是他的一，因为他有时要值班。

sentences.en: Then he said, Jean, it's your phone.
sentences.zh: 然后他说：“简，是你的电话。”

sentences.en: Her caller ID told her that it was Leshen, the president of the college.
sentences.zh: 她的来电显示告诉她，是学院院长莱申打来的。

sentences.en: So she rose from the bed and went to their bathroom.
sentences.zh: 于是她从床上起来，走进了他们的浴室。

sentences.en: She remembers Leshen's voice sounding heavy.
sentences.zh: 她记得莱申的声音听起来很沉重。

sentences.en: We lost another one.
sentences.zh: 我们又失去了一个。

sentences.en: After the call ended, she went downstairs and screamed.
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，她下楼尖叫起来。

sentences.en: I'm sure the entire neighborhood heard me, King says.
sentences.zh: 金说：“我确信整个社区都听到了我的声音。”

sentences.en: She hadn't known this student personally.
sentences.zh: 她以前并不认识这个学生。

sentences.en: But she feels passionately, she told me, that all WPI students are her kids.
sentences.zh: 但她告诉我，她深信所有WPI的学生都是她的孩子。

sentences.en: And she felt overcome by horror at what was unfolding, seemingly unstoppably among her students.
sentences.zh: 她感到被一种恐惧压倒，这种恐惧在她的学生中似乎势不可挡地展开着。

sentences.en: I just lost it, because we had finally brought people together, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我简直崩溃了，因为我们好不容易才把大家聚在一起。”

sentences.en: Her mind began racing.
sentences.zh: 她的脑海开始飞转。

sentences.en: What are we doing wrong?
sentences.zh: 我们哪里做错了？

sentences.en: What do we need to do to make this go away?
sentences.zh: 我们需要做什么才能让这一切消失？

sentences.en: What do I have to do personally?
sentences.zh: 我个人必须做什么？

sentences.en: What do I need from the community?
sentences.zh: 我需要社区做些什么？

sentences.en: She felt at a total loss.
sentences.zh: 她感到彻底无所适从。

sentences.en: How are we going to do this?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么做？

sentences.en: In classes, professors began to experiment with coping strategies.
sentences.zh: 在课堂上，教授们开始尝试应对策略。

sentences.en: Did they need to be more relaxed about deadlines?
sentences.zh: 他们需要对截止日期更放松一点吗？

sentences.en: Lighten coursework?
sentences.zh: 减轻课程负担？

sentences.en: Pursue tighter connections with students who seemed withdrawn?
sentences.zh: 与显得孤僻的学生建立更紧密的联系？

sentences.en: Steve Kamiotek, a professor of practice in chemical engineering who joined the task force,
sentences.zh: 化学工程实践教授史蒂夫·卡米奥泰克加入了该特别工作组，

sentences.en: explained to me that part of what was so terrifying was that the deaths didn't match previous patterns.
sentences.zh: 他向我解释，最可怕的部分之一是这些死亡与以往的模式不符。

sentences.en: Kamiotek had known to keep an eye on students who seemed withdrawn or disheveled.
sentences.zh: 卡米奥泰克本就知道要留意那些显得孤僻或衣衫不整的学生。

sentences.en: Students who stopped coming to class or exhibited erratic behavior.
sentences.zh: 停止上课或表现出反常行为的学生。

sentences.en: Students whose grades dipped.
sentences.zh: 成绩下降的学生。

sentences.en: But one of his students was among the dead.
sentences.zh: 但死者中有一位是他的学生。

sentences.en: And this student hadn't shown any of those signs.
sentences.zh: 而这个学生并没有表现出任何这些迹象。

sentences.en: Actually, none of the dead students matched the profile of a suicide risk.
sentences.zh: 事实上，死去的学生中没有一个符合自杀风险的特征。

sentences.en: That was frightening, Kamiotek said.
sentences.zh: 卡米奥泰克说：“这很可怕。”

sentences.en: He looked down at the table in his office.
sentences.zh: 他看着办公室里的桌子。

sentences.en: And he can't help, but could I have spotted it?
sentences.zh: 他忍不住想，我本可以发现吗？

sentences.en: Could I have done something?
sentences.zh: 我本可以做些什么吗？

sentences.en: Kamiotek, who was 65, took to giving out his cell phone number and checking in personally with students he knew were stressed.
sentences.zh: 65岁的卡米奥泰克开始向外公布自己的手机号码，并亲自去慰问那些他知道压力很大的学生。

sentences.en: A method several other professors I spoke to mentioned adopting, even though they didn't exactly have the time or bandwidth for that level of tabs keeping.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的其他几位教授也提到采用了这种方法，尽管他们并没有确切的时间或精力来进行这种程度的持续关注。

sentences.en: The job of calculating what this new era required, meanwhile, came to rest in part on the shoulders of data analysts like LeChasseur and Stacey Shaw,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，计算这个新时代需要什么的工作，部分落在了数据分析师勒沙瑟和斯泰西·肖的肩上，

sentences.en: who was then a new assistant professor of psychological and cognitive sciences.
sentences.zh: 后者当时是心理和认知科学系的一名新任助理教授。

sentences.en: The two women were part of a team assigned to take the quantitative data that had come in via surveys,
sentences.zh: 这两位女性是一个团队的成员，该团队负责处理通过调查收集到的定量数据，

sentences.en: as well as the recordings and transcripts of student, faculty, staff, and parent feedback,
sentences.zh: 以及学生、教师、员工和家长反馈的录音和文字记录，

sentences.en: and run an analysis that would explain, with the certainty of numbers, what was going wrong.
sentences.zh: 并进行分析，用数字的确定性来解释究竟出了什么问题。

sentences.en: The team coded all the transcripts and survey responses, identifying recurring phrases and key words, and then looking to see how often they were spoken and by whom.
sentences.zh: 该团队对所有文字记录和调查回复进行编码，确定重复出现的短语和关键词，然后查看它们的出现频率及说话者是谁。

sentences.en: Which key words and phrases occurred most frequently together?
sentences.zh: 哪些关键词和短语一起出现得最频繁？

sentences.en: From which parties?
sentences.zh: 来自哪些群体？

sentences.en: Running multiple increasingly complex analyses, they began to identify patterns.
sentences.zh: 通过运行多次日益复杂的分析，他们开始识别出模式。

sentences.en: Which members of the campus community were most affected by which kinds of stress, and how were they experiencing that stress academically and personally?
sentences.zh: 校园社区的哪些成员受哪种压力的影响最大，他们在学业和个人方面是如何体验这种压力的？

sentences.en: LeChasseur and Shaw worked together only on Zoom and over email, working past midnight most nights and on the weekends, too,
sentences.zh: 勒沙瑟和肖仅通过Zoom和电子邮件合作，几乎每天晚上都工作到午夜以后，周末也是如此，

sentences.en: haunted by the feeling that they were racing against the clock.
sentences.zh: 脑海里萦绕着一种与时间赛跑的感觉。

sentences.en: By the way, when you do this as a researcher, this can take years, LeChasseur told me.
sentences.zh: 勒沙瑟告诉我：“顺便说一句，作为研究人员，做这事可能需要几年时间。”

sentences.en: We were doing this in a month or two.
sentences.zh: 我们是在一两个月内完成的。

sentences.en: I was sitting with the two women in Shaw's office, a shady, spacious nook at the far end of one of the campus's newer buildings, with a large window overlooking wild grasses.
sentences.zh: 我和这两位女性坐在肖的办公室里，这是校园一栋较新建筑最内侧的一个阴凉、宽敞的角落，有一扇俯瞰野草的大窗户。

sentences.en: They had embraced at the beginning of our interview.
sentences.zh: 在采访开始时，他们拥抱了对方。

sentences.en: Though they spent the winter of 2021-22 in constant contact, they had never met in person.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们在2021至2022年的冬天保持着密切联系，但他们从未见过面。

sentences.en: We were flying by the seat of our pants, Shaw recalled.
sentences.zh: 肖回忆说：“我们当时完全是盲目摸索。”

sentences.en: It never felt like enough.
sentences.zh: 感觉永远不够。

sentences.en: And it never felt fast enough.
sentences.zh: 感觉速度也永远不够快。

sentences.en: Because it kept happening.
sentences.zh: 因为这种事不断发生。

sentences.en: And every time it did, no matter how much good work you did, or how much students said they appreciated whatever you did, you felt like you failed.
sentences.zh: 每当事情发生时，无论你做了多少优秀的工作，或者学生们说他们多么感激你所做的一切，你都觉得自己失败了。

sentences.en: Over and over again.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次。

sentences.en: The fifth death was a graduate student who died of a seizure in November.
sentences.zh: 第五起死亡是一名在11月因癫痫发作而去世的研究生。

sentences.en: The sixth was a senior in the mechanical engineering department who killed himself while home over the holiday break.
sentences.zh: 第六起是机械工程系的一名大四学生，他在假期回家期间自杀身亡。

sentences.en: The initial findings of the task force were distributed in January 2022.
sentences.zh: 特别工作组的初步调查结果于2022年1月发布。

sentences.en: Three days after the report came out, another student, a junior on the crew team, was found dead of an apparent suicide in his off-campus apartment.
sentences.zh: 报告发布三天后，另一名学生——赛艇队的一名大三学生，被发现死于校外公寓，疑似自杀。

sentences.en: This was perhaps the worst period on campus.
sentences.zh: 这或许是校园里最糟糕的一段时期。

sentences.en: Seven students had died in six months.
sentences.zh: 六个月内已有七名学生死亡。

sentences.en: There was no precedent for dealing with loss like this.
sentences.zh: 应对这样的损失没有先例。

sentences.en: No one knew when it would end.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道这一切何时会结束。

sentences.en: And the task force's implementation team had only just received a list of recommendations.
sentences.zh: 而特别工作组的执行团队才刚刚收到一份建议清单。

sentences.en: Following research that indicates that spending too much time talking about or commemorating a student who has died by suicide can risk contagion,
sentences.zh: 根据相关研究表明，花太多时间谈论或纪念因自杀身亡的学生可能会带来传染的风险，

sentences.en: Morrison-Leshen encouraged the faculty to retain as normal an educational experience as possible.
sentences.zh: 莫里森-莱申鼓励教职员工尽可能保持正常的教育经历。

sentences.en: The university had organized no memorials or vigils.
sentences.zh: 该大学没有组织任何纪念活动或守夜活动。

sentences.en: Many students and parents found this baffling.
sentences.zh: 许多学生和家长对此感到匪夷所思。

sentences.en: Students published an open letter that February calling WPI's response to the deaths inconsistent and trauma-inducing and suggesting that the lack of time
sentences.zh: 学生们在当年2月发表了一封公开信，称WPI对这些死亡事件的反应前后矛盾且会引发心理创伤，并暗示缺乏时间

sentences.en: for group reflection and grief disregarded the gravity of recent tragedies.
sentences.zh: 进行集体反思和悲伤忽视了最近悲剧的严重性。

sentences.en: A new student group called the Mental Health Committee organized a support walk for an evening in February, at which students formed a candlelight processional
sentences.zh: 一个名为心理健康委员会的新学生组织在2月的一个晚上组织了一场支持步行，学生们组成了烛光游行队伍

sentences.en: and exchanged flowers to demonstrate community resilience.
sentences.zh: 并交换鲜花以展示社区的韧性。

sentences.en: Local florists donated thousands of flowers.
sentences.zh: 当地的花店捐赠了数千朵花。

sentences.en: Mothers from the community lined up to give hugs to any student that needed one.
sentences.zh: 社区的母亲们排着队给任何需要拥抱的学生一个拥抱。

sentences.en: It felt like life or death, says Bryn Scott McWilliams, who was a freshman when she joined the committee.
sentences.zh: 加入委员会时还是一名大一新生的布琳·斯科特·麦克威廉姆斯说：“这感觉就像生死攸关。”

sentences.en: It felt like the life of the student body was on our shoulders.
sentences.zh: 感觉学生群体的生命压在我们的肩膀上。

sentences.en: This was, of course, how the faculty and administration felt as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，教职员工和行政人员也是这种感觉。

sentences.en: The pressure to get this right was immense,
sentences.zh: 把这件事做对的压力是巨大的，

sentences.en: Morse told me.
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯告诉我。

sentences.en: That winter, he would often see a truck belonging to a document-shredding company on his daily commute to work and long more than anything to be a shredder.
sentences.zh: 那年冬天，他每天上班通勤时经常看到一辆属于文件碎纸公司的卡车，并且最渴望能成为一名碎纸工。

sentences.en: Broadly, the analysis run by LeChasser and Shaw identified several issues requiring immediate intervention.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，勒沙瑟和肖进行的分析指出了几个需要立即进行干预的问题。

sentences.en: Intense academic pressure, insufficient self-care habits among the students, lack of social connection, insufficient awareness of information
sentences.zh: 巨大的学业压力、学生中自我关怀习惯不足、缺乏社交联系、对WPI现有健康资源信息的了解不足

sentences.en: about the existing health resources at WPI, and pandemic burnout.
sentences.zh: 以及大流行带来的精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The task force had several clear recommendations that could be implemented almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 特别工作组提出了几项可以几乎立即实施的明确建议。

sentences.en: Hire more counselors for the health center, increase the number of mental health trainings available to the faculty and staff, expand student mentoring programs,
sentences.zh: 为健康中心聘请更多咨询师，增加面向教职员工的心理健康培训数量，扩大学生辅导项目，

sentences.en: build up social programming for students, giving them more opportunities to make friends and feel connected to the campus community.
sentences.zh: 加强学生的社交活动，为他们提供更多交友和融入校园社区的机会。

sentences.en: Once a term, set aside a day to cancel classes and meetings so that everyone could do something, not homework, that would boost their well-being.
sentences.zh: 每个学期腾出一天取消课程和会议，以便每个人都能做一些能提升幸福感的事情，而不是写家庭作业。

sentences.en: Fu had served on a subcommittee dedicated to evaluating what changes in pedagogy might be required to meet the moment.
sentences.zh: 傅曾在一个小组委员会中服务，该委员会致力于评估为了适应当前形势可能需要对教学法进行哪些更改。

sentences.en: Their findings tracked with broader trends in secondary education.
sentences.zh: 他们的发现与高等教育的更广泛趋势一致。

sentences.en: It became really clear that we couldn't continue viewing students exclusively in terms of how they performed in our classes, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“很明显，我们不能再单纯地从他们在我们课上的表现来看待学生。”

sentences.en: We needed to understand students as whole people, and we needed to develop a much more personalized approach.
sentences.zh: 我们需要将学生理解为完整的人，我们需要开发一种更加个性化的方法。

sentences.en: The task force recommended that faculty members incorporate students' mental health and well-being into their teaching priorities, whether that meant talking openly
sentences.zh: 特别工作组建议教职员工将学生的心理健康和福祉纳入其教学重点，无论是公开谈论

sentences.en: about their own struggles, beginning class with meditation, or being more willing to grant student requests for extensions or accommodations.
sentences.zh: 他们自己的挣扎、以冥想开始课堂，还是更愿意批准学生延期或调整安排的请求。

sentences.en: Some professors balked.
sentences.zh: 一些教授表示反对。

sentences.en: A lot of faculty were really pushing back and expressing resistance,
sentences.zh: 许多教职员工真的在推脱并表达抵触情绪，

sentences.en: Fu said.
sentences.zh: 傅说。

sentences.en: You know, we weren't trained in this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们没有受过这方面的培训。

sentences.en: I really don't feel comfortable engaging with students in this way.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得以这种方式与学生互动很不自在。

sentences.en: Attending to individual student needs takes more time,
sentences.zh: 傅承认，照顾学生的个人需求需要更多时间，

sentences.en: Fu acknowledged, and deciding how and whether to agree to student requests requires mental and ethical effort.
sentences.zh: 而且决定如何以及是否同意学生的请求需要心理和道德上的努力。

sentences.en: Some pleas for extensions or course adjustments can't be granted without making the instructor workload unmanageable or risking unfairness to other students.
sentences.zh: 如果不让教师的工作量变得难以管理，或者不冒对其他学生不公的风险，有些关于延期或课程调整的恳求是无法被批准的。

sentences.en: Not all students feel comfortable advocating for themselves, and often the most structurally disadvantaged students don't ask for help.
sentences.zh: 并非所有学生都乐于为自己发声，而且往往结构性处于弱势地位的学生不会寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Is it fair to grant an extraordinary request to someone simply because they're emboldened enough to ask?
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为某人有足够的胆量去请求，就批准其非同寻常的请求，这公平吗？

sentences.en: How is a professor supposed to evaluate whether a student need is acute enough to make extraordinary accommodations?
sentences.zh: 教授该如何评估学生的需求是否严重到足以做出非同寻常的迁就？

sentences.en: Earlier this year, the Healthy Minds Study, which runs surveys on the mental health of post-secondary students and faculty members, confirmed that this extra work
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，“健康心灵研究”发布了关于高等教育学生和教职员工心理健康的调查，证实了这种额外的工作

sentences.en: is unevenly distributed.
sentences.zh: 分布不均。

sentences.en: Female, trans, and non-binary faculty members were much more likely to be supporting students through mental health challenges than male faculty members.
sentences.zh: 女性、跨性别和非二元性别教职员工比男性教职员工更有可能在心理健康挑战方面支持学生。

sentences.en: Faculty members of color were more likely to do so than their white colleagues.
sentences.zh: 有色人种教职员工比他们的白人同事更有可能这样做。

sentences.en: More junior, mid-career faculty members took on more of this work than late-career colleagues.
sentences.zh: 较年轻、处于职业生涯中期的教职员工承担了比资深同事更多的工作。

sentences.en: In other words, the people spending the most time addressing and accommodating student mental health needs are the ones who are most likely to be lower paid, with less authority,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，花最多时间解决和适应学生心理健康需求的人，往往是最有可能薪水较低、权力较小、

sentences.en: and less job security.
sentences.zh: 且工作保障较少的人。

sentences.en: Adjunct and contingent faculty members often undertake this work at several jobs simultaneously for separate institutions, without benefits.
sentences.zh: 兼职和合同制教职员工通常在没有福利的情况下，同时为不同机构的多份工作承担这项工作。

sentences.en: One way to think about this is as a cascade effect.
sentences.zh: 思考这个问题的一种方式是将其视为级联效应。

sentences.en: There's often a critical shortage of mental health professionals on campuses who can address student need, particularly for Black,
sentences.zh: 校园里往往严重缺乏能够解决学生需求的心理健康专业人员，特别是针对黑人、

sentences.en: Latino, and Asian students.
sentences.zh: 拉丁裔和亚裔学生。

sentences.en: In the absence of sufficient mental health scaffolding, faculty members have found themselves stepping into a new, time-consuming dynamic with their students
sentences.zh: 在缺乏足够的心理健康支持体系的情况下，教职员工发现自己与学生陷入了一种新的、耗时的互动动态中

sentences.en: that doesn't always feel clearly defined or sustainable.
sentences.zh: 这并不总是显得界限清晰或可持续。

sentences.en: During one of my visits to WPI, I spoke with Zoe Reidinger, an associate professor of biomedical engineering, and Adrian Hall-Phillips, an associate professor of marketing
sentences.zh: 在我访问伍斯特理工学院（WPI）期间，我采访了生物医学工程副教授佐伊·赖丁格（Zoe Reidinger）

sentences.en: in the business school.
sentences.zh: 以及商学院的市场营销副教授

sentences.en: They had each been asked to join the task force.
sentences.zh: 阿德里安·霍尔-菲利普斯（Adrian Hall-Phillips）。

sentences.en: We met in Reidinger's office, which is invitingly decorated, with a fuzzy green couch that looked strikingly like the face of Oscar the Grouch, and an extensive selection of tea.
sentences.zh: 我们是在赖丁格的办公室里见面的，那里的装饰十分温馨吸引人，有一个长得酷似“垃圾桶奥斯卡”脸庞的毛茸茸绿色沙发，还有种类繁多的茶水。

sentences.en: Reidinger's dog, Lydia, vied for a spot on the Oscar the Couch.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格的狗莉迪亚（Lydia）正争抢着想在“奥斯卡沙发”上占一个位置。

sentences.en: Hall-Phillips teaches in the business school and is the most senior black female professor on campus, in terms of years at WPI.
sentences.zh: 霍尔-菲利普斯在商学院任教，按在WPI的任职年限计算，她是校园里资历最深的黑人女性教授。

sentences.en: Reidinger is non-binary and neurodivergent.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格是非二元性别者且神经多样性。

sentences.en: When they were hired, ten years ago, they were the only out queer faculty member on campus, they told me.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，十年前他们被录用时，是校园里唯一公开出柜的酷儿教职员工。

sentences.en: The two professors are close friends and act like beacons for minority students on campus, even those they don't teach and have never met.
sentences.zh: 这两位教授是密友，她们就像是校园里少数族裔学生的指路明灯，甚至包括那些她们没教过、也从未见过的学生。

sentences.en: We are resources for black students and queer students.
sentences.zh: 我们是黑人学生和酷儿学生的资源。

sentences.en: And plenty of other others,
sentences.zh: 还有许许多多其他学生，

sentences.en: Reidinger told me, smiling.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格微笑着告诉我。

sentences.en: All the others,
sentences.zh: 所有其他的学生，

sentences.en: Hall-Phillips confirmed.
sentences.zh: 霍尔-菲利普斯予以证实。

sentences.en: It's something that we talk about all the time, that this part of what we do is not actually in our job description.
sentences.zh: 这是我们经常谈论的一件事，我们所做的这部分工作其实并不在我们的职位描述里。

sentences.en: They are inundated with student requests for advice, mentorship, and care.
sentences.zh: 她们收到了大量学生寻求建议、指导和关怀的请求。

sentences.en: Hall-Phillips lets students book individual appointments with her via an open calendar, with slots occurring several days a week.
sentences.zh: 霍尔-菲利普斯让学生通过一个开放的日程表与她预约一对一会面，每周有几天的时间段可供选择。

sentences.en: As of that afternoon, the next open appointment was more than four weeks away.
sentences.zh: 截至那天下午，下一个可预约的时间已经是一个多月以后了。

sentences.en: She was also texting with a student who wanted to check in.
sentences.zh: 她当时还在和一名想要了解近况的学生发短信。

sentences.en: She would later duck out of our conversation early and catch the student during the walk to her next appointment.
sentences.zh: 她后来会提前结束我们的对话，并在走向下一个预约地点的途中拦住那名学生。

sentences.en: Reidinger gets so many requests that they keep their schedule, and Lydia's, on their office door.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格收到的请求太多了，以至于他们把自己的日程表和莉迪亚的日程表都贴在了办公室门上。

sentences.en: For a time, they stocked the refrigerator in their outer office with jars of chili for students who might be worrying about how to afford dinner.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他们在办公室外间的冰箱里储藏了一罐罐辣椒酱，留给那些可能担心吃不起晚饭的学生。

sentences.en: I mentioned the concern about equity I saw in the
sentences.zh: 我提到了我在《健康心灵研究》中看到的

sentences.en: Healthy Minds study, and heard about from faculty members that I interviewed all over the country.
sentences.zh: 以及从全国各地采访的教职员工那里听到的关于公平的担忧。

sentences.en: Women,
sentences.zh: 女性、

sentences.en: LGBTQ faculty members, and faculty members of color already face structural disadvantages in academia when it comes to pay equity and securing tenure.
sentences.zh: LGBTQ教职员工以及有色人种教职员工在学术界的薪酬公平和终身教职保障方面，已经面临结构性劣势。

sentences.en: If these same faculty members spend vast reserves of time and energy caring for students in distress, work that frequently goes unacknowledged, instead of completing
sentences.zh: 如果这些相同的教职员工花费大量的时间和精力去关怀处于困境中的学生——这项工作经常得不到认可——而不是去完成

sentences.en: research or traditional administrative service work, that gap can widen further.
sentences.zh: 研究或传统的行政服务工作，这种差距可能会进一步拉大。

sentences.en: Both of them seemed to sigh and laugh at the same time.
sentences.zh: 她们两人似乎同时叹了口气又笑了起来。

sentences.en: Am I pissed off about it?
sentences.zh: 我对此感到生气吗？

sentences.en: Hall Phillips said tartly.
sentences.zh: 霍尔-菲利普斯尖锐地说。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do I wish there were some other individuals?
sentences.zh: 我希望有其他一些人吗？

sentences.en: who would pick up a little bit more of the slack?
sentences.zh: 能多承担一点责任？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Particularly our white males.
sentences.zh: 尤其是我们的白人男性。

sentences.en: Reitinger snorted.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格哼了一声。

sentences.en: But I can't focus on that because if I focus on that, the students that are in need won't get the help they need.
sentences.zh: 但我不能把注意力放在那上面，因为如果我关注那个，那些有需要的学生就得不到他们需要的帮助。

sentences.en: They just won't get it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是得不到。

sentences.en: And that's what's more important to me.
sentences.zh: 而这对我来说更重要。

sentences.en: Both Reitinger and Hall Phillips were emphatic that they love working at WPI.
sentences.zh: 赖丁格和霍尔-菲利普斯都强调她们非常热爱在WPI的工作。

sentences.en: They would like to see more faculty and staff members who look like them, but broadly, they think the administration cares immensely for its students and is doing a good job.
sentences.zh: 她们希望能看到更多长得像她们这样的教职员工，但总的来说，她们认为学校管理层非常关心学生，并且做得很好。

sentences.en: They know that when they need to refer a student for serious help, the student will receive it, and they have direct lines and first-name relationships
sentences.zh: 她们知道，当需要将学生转介给专业帮助时，学生会得到这种帮助，她们与咨询中心的心理健康专业人士

sentences.en: with the mental health professionals in the counseling center.
sentences.zh: 有直接联系渠道和直呼其名的熟悉关系。

sentences.en: But they're also candid about the sacrifices they're making.
sentences.zh: 但她们也坦诚自己所做出的牺牲。

sentences.en: The 21-22 school year of chaos and sadness was a wake-up call for all of us,
sentences.zh: 充满混乱和悲伤的21-22学年对我们所有人来说都是一记警钟，

sentences.en: Hall Phillips said.
sentences.zh: 霍尔-菲利普斯说。

sentences.en: Not just revamping all of our mental health resources on campus, but looking at faculty and staff and recognizing, oh, they're burned out too.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是重组我们校园里所有的心理健康资源，还要审视教职员工并认识到，哦，他们也筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: Oh, they're suffering too.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们也在受苦。

sentences.en: Were you burned out?
sentences.zh: 你们当时精疲力竭了吗？

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.zh: 我问。

sentences.en: Her face was flat.
sentences.zh: 她面无表情。

sentences.en: I still am, she said.
sentences.zh: 我现在依然如此，她说。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I still am.
sentences.zh: 我依然如此。

sentences.en: Worcester is famous for the snow dumps it receives in the winter.
sentences.zh: 伍斯特以其冬天的暴雪而闻名。

sentences.en: It has something to do with where the city is in relation to the Appalachian Mountains.
sentences.zh: 这与该市相对于阿巴拉契亚山脉的地理位置有关。

sentences.en: The clouds bear down when the temperature drops, and then the snow is relentless and the weather is brutal.
sentences.zh: 当气温骤降时，云层压顶，接着便是无休止的大雪和残酷的天气。

sentences.en: All winter, it's brutal, brutal,
sentences.zh: 整个冬天都是残酷的、残酷的，

sentences.en: and then somehow, slowly, it's not anymore.
sentences.zh: 然后不知为何，慢慢地，就不再那么残酷了。

sentences.en: That's kind of how the end of WPI's crisis arrived.
sentences.zh: WPI危机结束的方式大致也是如此。

sentences.en: No one I spoke to could quite explain how they knew that the emergency had subsided.
sentences.zh: 我采访的没有人能准确解释他们是如何知道紧急情况已经消退的。

sentences.en: The most they could be sure of was that, one moment in the spring of 2022, they felt intuitively that the last death was behind them.
sentences.zh: 他们能确定的最多是，在2022年春天的某个时刻，他们凭直觉感到最后一次死亡已经过去。

sentences.en: Between summer 2021 and winter 2022, the faculty existed in a state of suspension.
sentences.zh: 从2021年夏天到2022年冬天，全体教职员工一直处于一种悬而未决的状态中。

sentences.en: We were always waiting, waiting for the next, if there was going to be a next,
sentences.zh: 我们总是在等待，等待下一个，如果还会有下一个的话，

sentences.en: Fu said, like waiting for the other shoe to drop.
sentences.zh: 傅说，就像等待另一只靴子落地一样。

sentences.en: But then, somewhere deep into the winter, she said, it just became apparent that it was over.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在冬天的某个深处，她说，这一切显然已经结束了。

sentences.en: There was no clear point of demarcation, just a subtle shift.
sentences.zh: 没有明确的分界点，只有一个微妙的转变。

sentences.en: The campus culture felt so much lighter, she said, like we had been through this traumatic experience, but we could somehow see the point at the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 校园文化感觉轻松多了，她说，就像我们经历了这段创伤性的经历，但我们不知怎么地看到了隧道尽头的曙光。

sentences.en: Something was somehow over.
sentences.zh: 某种东西不知怎么地结束了。

sentences.en: King said she knew it had ended, when sometime during the spring, people began looking at one another square in the face again.
sentences.zh: 金说她知道危机已经结束，那是在春天的某个时候，人们开始重新正视对方的脸。

sentences.en: For months, it seemed as though no one could bear eye contact.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，似乎没有人能够承受眼神交流。

sentences.en: In that pain, you usually don't want to.
sentences.zh: 在那种痛苦中，你通常不愿意这样做。

sentences.en: If I look you in the eye, I could feel your pain.
sentences.zh: 如果我看着你的眼睛，我就会感受到你的痛苦。

sentences.en: And then one day, something had changed.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，情况变了。

sentences.en: People started looking me in the eye, and I knew they were smiling, although I couldn't see the smile, she said, gesturing to indicate the masks everyone wore at the time.
sentences.zh: 人们开始看着我的眼睛，我知道他们在笑，尽管我看不到笑容，她说着，指了指当时每个人都戴着的口罩。

sentences.en: And I knew we were turning the corner.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们正在度过难关。

sentences.en: People were looking at me in the eye, like just looking at me, and I was looking at them.
sentences.zh: 人们在看着我的眼睛，就像只是看着我，而我也在看着他们。

sentences.en: It is clear by now that the mental health crisis has changed academia forever.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，很明显，心理健康危机已经永远改变了学术界。

sentences.en: Its structures, its culture, and the function it is expected to perform in American society.
sentences.zh: 它的结构、它的文化，以及它在美国社会中被期望发挥的功能。

sentences.en: More than half of American college students now report depression, anxiety, or seriously considering suicide.
sentences.zh: 如今，超过一半的美国大学生报告称有抑郁、焦虑或曾认真考虑过自杀。

sentences.en: This is a problem that reaches across geography, race, class, identity, institutional resources, or prestige and academic ability.
sentences.zh: 这是一个跨越地理、种族、阶级、身份、机构资源、声望和学术能力的问题。

sentences.en: Almost one in four Americans in college considered dropping out in the last year because of their mental health.
sentences.zh: 几乎四分之一的美国大学生在过去一年里因为心理健康问题考虑过退学。

sentences.en: Adjusting pedagogy to account for this scale of illness, and in some cases disability, is the new frontier of post-secondary education.
sentences.zh: 调整教学法以应对这种规模的疾病——在某些情况下是残疾——是高等教育的新前沿。

sentences.en: In early 2022,
WPI opened a large new
sentences.zh: WPI在学校主食堂旁边开设了一个全新的

sentences.en: Center for Well-Being right next to the school's main cafeteria, as if to declare that wellness is central to the school's institutional mission.
sentences.zh: 福祉中心（Center for Well-Being），仿佛在宣告身心健康是学校机构使命的核心。

sentences.en: By the time I visited Worcester this fall, nearly all the short-term recommendations made by the task force and several from Riverside's independent review had been implemented.
sentences.zh: 当我今年秋天访问伍斯特时，工作组提出的几乎所有短期建议以及河滨独立审查报告中的几项建议都已付诸实施。

sentences.en: Morse told me that mental health care should be a campus-wide effort, requiring the participation of every single member of the community.
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯告诉我，心理健康关怀应该是全校范围内的努力，需要社区的每一位成员参与。

sentences.en: He cited an ongoing program
sentences.zh: 他提到了一个WPI称之为“关怀团队”的持续项目，

sentences.en: WPI calls the Care Team, which is responsible for coordinating an immediate response when a student is flagged as at-risk.
sentences.zh: 该团队负责在学生被标记为处于危险之中时协调立即做出反应。

sentences.en: Anyone in the community can register concern about a student with the Care Team, and that same day, the team will have quietly reached out to that student's contacts, dean,
sentences.zh: 社区中的任何人都可以向关怀团队表达对某位学生的担忧，同一天，团队就会悄悄联系该学生的联系人、院长、

sentences.en: professors, and the counseling center to see about approaching that student with support.
sentences.zh: 教授和咨询中心，商讨如何带着支持去接近这位学生。

sentences.en: Morse told me that he recently heard from a janitor in a dining hall who had come to one of the training sessions to learn how to identify students in trouble,
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯告诉我，他最近听到食堂里的一名清洁工说，他曾参加过一次培训课程，学习如何识别陷入困境的学生，

sentences.en: figuring that he should know.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己应该了解这些。

sentences.en: To Morse, this was a perfect example of the new paradigm.
sentences.zh: 对莫尔斯来说，这是新范式的完美例证。

sentences.en: Like many universities,
sentences.zh: 就像许多大学一样，

sentences.en: WPI's focus has evolved from taking responsibility solely for the academic education of its students to becoming the custodian of individual student wellness.
sentences.zh: WPI的重点已经从仅对学生的学术教育负责，演变为成为单个学生身心健康的守护者。

sentences.en: This is, perhaps, the new vanguard, the academic institution as wellness community.
sentences.zh: 这或许是新的前沿，即作为福祉社区的学术机构。

sentences.en: It has a slight dystopian ring to it.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点反乌托邦。

sentences.en: The all-encompassing beneficent administrative machine with eyes everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这个无所不包、行善的行政机器有着无处不在的眼睛。

sentences.en: And yet, the circumstances producing these conditions seem to justify it.
sentences.zh: 然而，产生这些状况的环境似乎使其合情合理。

sentences.en: Many students who struggle with their mental health or suicidal feelings never reach out to a counselor.
sentences.zh: 许多与心理健康或自杀倾向作斗争的学生从未向辅导员求助。

sentences.en: The school's goal is to reach struggling students however it can, during classes, on scheduled rest days, through the entire community, including the janitors.
sentences.zh: 学校的目标是以各种可能的方式接触陷入困境的学生：在课堂上、在预定的休息日、通过整个社区，包括清洁工。

sentences.en: WPI is collaborating with the University of Massachusetts
sentences.zh: WPI正与马萨诸塞大学

sentences.en: Chan Medical School on a research project that uses an AI mobile app designed to monitor and predict suicide risk among college students who opt into the study
sentences.zh: 陈医学院合作开展一个研究项目，该项目使用一个AI移动应用程序，旨在通过被动监测数据和声调，来监测和预测同意参与研究的大学生中的自杀风险。

sentences.en: by passively surveilling data and vocal tone.
sentences.zh: 通过被动监测数据和声调。

sentences.en: Morse believes in communicating openly about the imperfect and difficult search for best practices.
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯坚信，应当公开交流寻找最佳实践过程中的不完美与艰难。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of the crisis, senior leadership heard from some colleagues at other universities who were incredulous at WPI's decision to be so open about what was happening.
sentences.zh: 危机过后，高层领导听到其他大学的一些同事对WPI决定如此公开地谈论所发生的事情感到难以置信。

sentences.en: Some schools keep their suicides out of the public eye, sometimes to honor family privacy, but also to avoid having the institution's name sullied.
sentences.zh: 有些学校将自杀事件排除在公众视线之外，有时是为了尊重家庭隐私，但也是为了避免学校的名誉受损。

sentences.en: We made the choice to talk about it, to be as honest and brave as we could,
sentences.zh: 我们做出了公开谈论它的选择，做到尽可能诚实和勇敢，

sentences.en: Morse told me, in part because
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯告诉我，部分原因是

sentences.en: WPI officials believed that sharing their experiences, their process, and their data could help other schools navigating similar territory.
sentences.zh: WPI的官员们相信，分享他们的经历、他们的过程和他们的数据可以帮助其他正在应对类似情况的学校。

sentences.en: But also,
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是，

sentences.en: Morse said, talking about that work, that's what this campus community needed as part of the healing.
sentences.zh: 莫尔斯说，谈论那项工作，正是这个校园社区作为疗愈的一部分所需要的。

sentences.en: This is what happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是所发生的事情。

sentences.en: This is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: This is what's working.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在起作用的方法。

sentences.en: This is where we're going.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们要去的地方。

sentences.en: With transparency.
sentences.zh: 本着透明的原则。

sentences.en: He pointed out that the Center for Well-Being now features prominently in the school's admissions tours.
sentences.zh: 他指出，福祉中心现在已经是学校招生参观的重点特色。

sentences.en: The campus felt, on the sunny days I visited in the fall, energetic and cheerful.
sentences.zh: 在我秋天访问的那些阳光明媚的日子里，校园充满了活力和欢快。

sentences.en: Undergrads threw frisbees on the lawn outside the Center for Well-Being, and a weekly farmer's market sold fruit and flowers nearby.
sentences.zh: 本科生在福祉中心外面的草坪上扔飞盘，附近的一个每周农贸市场出售着水果和鲜花。

sentences.en: On one of the college sidewalks, students browsed through tables of posters they could buy for their dorm rooms, the same ones that have hung in dorm rooms for decades.
sentences.zh: 在大学的一条人行道上，学生们浏览着摆放海报的桌子，他们可以买下这些海报挂在宿舍里，这些海报几十年来一直挂在宿舍里。

sentences.en: The Beatles at Abbey Road,
sentences.zh: 披头士乐队的《艾比路》，

sentences.en: Vincent van Gogh's
sentences.zh: 文森特·梵高的

sentences.en: The Starry Night,
sentences.zh: 《星夜》，

sentences.en: Marilyn Monroe with her skirt swirling about her shoulders,
sentences.zh: 玛丽莲·梦露裙裾飞扬的照片，

sentences.en: a bronze goat statue supervised the quad,
sentences.zh: 一尊青铜山羊雕像俯瞰着方庭，

sentences.en: WPI's mascot is Gumpy the Goat, and someone told me that when students matriculate, they are welcomed as part of the herd.
sentences.zh: WPI的吉祥物是山羊甘比（Gumpy the Goat），有人告诉我，当学生入学时，他们就被当作羊群的一部分受到欢迎。

sentences.en: One morning, I attended a session of Catherine Fu's course son's smart and sustainable cities, which began with a technique she has been using for the last year.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，我参加了凯瑟琳·傅的“智能与可持续城市”课程的一节课，课程以她过去一年一直在使用的一种技巧开始。

sentences.en: She sounded a singing bowl three times, and asked everyone to take three deep breaths each time.
sentences.zh: 她敲响了三次颂钵，并要求每个人每次都做三次深呼吸。

sentences.en: As the reverberations from the bowl slowly fell silent,
sentences.zh: 随着颂钵的余音渐渐归于沉寂，

sentences.en: Fu went alphabetically by last name down the roster, asking each student to tell the group his or her name, and to add a word describing how they felt.
sentences.zh: 傅按点名册上姓氏的字母顺序依次点名，要求每个学生向大家说出自己的名字，并加上一个描述自己感受的词。

sentences.en: One by one, the students responded.
sentences.zh: 学生们一个接一个地回答。

sentences.en: I'm feeling relaxed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很放松。

sentences.en: I'm feeling stressed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很有压力。

sentences.en: I'm feeling hydrated.
sentences.zh: 我觉得水分充足。

sentences.en: I still don't know what I'm feeling.
sentences.zh: 我还是不知道自己是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Soft laughter rocked around the room for the student and his inscrutable feelings.
sentences.zh: 屋里爆发出一阵温和的笑声，送给这个学生和他那不可捉摸的感受。

sentences.en: I was reminded of something
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了

sentences.en: King said to me earlier in the day about collectivity being key to both individual and community resilience.
sentences.zh: 金在早些时候对我说过的话，关于集体性是个人和社区韧性的关键。

sentences.en: I had asked her what the future of this issue was.
sentences.zh: 我曾问过她这个问题未来会怎样。

sentences.en: What was the way to move forward in the face of the massive challenges, pedagogical, structural, personal, facing educators and students alike?
sentences.zh: 面对教育工作者和学生共同面临的巨大挑战——教学方面的、结构方面的、个人方面的，前进的道路是什么？

sentences.en: I expected her maybe to say something about neurobiology and forward thinking, or about institutional policy.
sentences.zh: 我本以为她可能会说一些关于神经生物学和前瞻性思维，或者关于机构政策的事情。

sentences.en: Instead, she said this,
sentences.zh: 相反，她这样说道，

sentences.en: I think all of us have to be able to say to each other, and even to the people who are suffering.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所有人都必须能够对彼此说，甚至对那些正在受苦的人说：

sentences.en: This is difficult.
sentences.zh: 这很艰难。

sentences.en: This is difficult for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说很难。

sentences.en: I feel you.
sentences.zh: 我理解你。

sentences.en: I'll try to help but know that I may not be perfect.
sentences.zh: 我会尽量帮忙，但要知道我可能做不到完美。

sentences.en: We all have to take that up.
sentences.zh: 我们都必须承担起这一点。

sentences.en: That we're trying.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们在努力。

sentences.en: That we're trying.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们在努力。

sentences.en: That's all we can say.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所能说的全部了。

sentences.en: She thought for a few seconds quietly and then spoke again.
sentences.zh: 她静静地思考了几秒钟，然后又开口了。

sentences.en: I think that's what community is.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是社群的意义所在。

sentences.en: Coming together and saying,
sentences.zh: 聚在一起并说道：

sentences.en: I'm vulnerable, just like you are.
sentences.zh: 我很脆弱，就像你一样。

sentences.en: I'm trying.
sentences.zh: 我在努力。

sentences.en: I'm not going to leave you alone.
sentences.zh: 我不会让你孤单一人。

sentences.zh: 如果您有自杀的想法，请致电或发短信

sentences.zh: 988 以联系
